crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-23 Vietnam time (a scan for 23 Oct, one day after the 22 Oct crawl).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.5 -> 96.5; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). One-day step from 22 Oct. PERFORMANCE holds at 98: all 118 pages are under one second; site mean TTFB 310.4 ms (311.2 on 22 Oct, median 256 vs 255) and the ceiling rises 581 -> 774 ms (/articles/3d-renders-for-property-developers-melbourne) but stays well under 1 s. CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: 118/118 return 200, 0 orphans; total distinct internal links rise 2,706 -> 2,799 (23.72 per page; the template link is back on the articles) while 3 articles (one more than yesterday: /articles/architectural-visualisation-adelaide) are linked only from the hub. ON-PAGE holds at 93: /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still cross-canonical (self canonical 117/118). STRUCTURED DATA holds at 98 (FAQPage 95/95, 407 blocks). CONTENT holds at 93: no new article since 24 Sep (29 days); words 243,021 -> 243,401 (+380, only /articles/3d-rendering-adelaide changed, 3,073 -> 3,453).
